text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I had a proper dinner yesterday and went to bed earlier than usual, after all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"Back home, they'd always say,
"The early bird gets the worm.""

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Doing radio calisthenics will make you even healthier!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: You should try doing it next time too, Trainer.
Seeing Oguri Cap full of vitality,I felt a wave of relief.
